understandsHome: Why Klar executed, confirmed, or stopped
parseHint: Lab is the Assist path for the selected language. Decision and intents here are what Klar runs. Sentence triggers run only if Klar is unreachable.
customHint: Phrase onto a known intent. Policies sit beside this, not as HA automations.
emptyBundle: No recordings yet. Enable the bundle and try a sentence.
graphHint: Rooms as clusters, devices coloured by confidence.
nluRagHint: Off by default. Matched slice only, never Assist tools.
languageHint: An empty list keeps every compiled Assist locale. Pinning one pack is the usual household.
operatorLanguageHint: This app only. Saved here, or KLAR_UI_LOCALE before the first save. Not Assist, not the Home Assistant profile.
engineHint: Voice, languages, and the LLM live here. Home Assistant only connects the engine.
assistLanguagesHint: Which packs Klar may parse. The satellite still sends one language per request. Empty = all compiled locales.
voiceHint: Personality and spoken replies. Assist reads this from the engine, not from Home Assistant options.
extraPromptHint: Optional line on top of the packed personality. Leave empty unless you need a house-specific rule.
personalityPromptHint: What the engine LLM gets for this voice. Extra prompt below is optional and house-specific.
refineSpeechHint: Klar still controls devices. The engine LLM then rewrites finished NLU replies in this voice.
quietAckHint: On a simple light or switch on/off, skip TTS and play a chime on the satellite.
calendarLlmHint: Klar still reads the calendar. On: the LLM speaks the events. Off: Klar speaks the list.
allowLlmToolsHint: Off by default. On: the chat model may control Home Assistant. Off: Klar skips that agent when it has tools.
missHint: Optional layers after a deterministic reject. None of these put a model on parse.
operatorChromeHint: Theme and chrome language for operators. Not Assist.
haGlueHint: Home Assistant Configure only needs engine URL, token, channel, and an optional leftover conversation agent. Voice and LLM stay here.
settingsGuide: Set these three, then map the house.
mappingHint: Mapping is aliases for graph entities. Calendars appear after the calendar domain is included. Assist follows the language pack; this chrome follows the operator language.
nluIgnore: Do not bind for status or power
nluIgnoreHint: Drops this device from the resolver. Use for misnamed helpers.
journalHint: Last 200 turns, 24 hours, redacted. Raw text only with the bundle.
mixCaption: Source: conversation journal, turns per day
coverageCaption: Source: home graph, share of devices
triggerFirst: Klar parse, then that path. Assist does not run a different intent, a sentence trigger, or a weather fallback.
payloadTemplate: Home Assistant template; {{ text }} is the utterance
payloadLlm: System prompt for the fallback agent
routineHint: A spoken name starts a Home Assistant script. Good night wins over the greeting.
routineInvalid: A phrase and script.xxx are required.
tryTheseHint: Tap a sentence to try it in the lab.
personalityHa: Voice, languages, and the LLM live on this Settings page.
governEmpty: Safety seeds ship with every pack. Off writes a house override; the compiled floor stays on.
matchReadOnly: Missing row uses the engine default. Empty overlay is today’s candidate list.
matchDisableWarning: Disabling area_command or all_lights changes room-wide and whole-home commands.
trainerHint: Klar calls an OpenAI-compatible model in Rust. Chat, validate, then apply per lane. No Home Assistant LLM integration is required. Advanced JSON is for debug.
trainerNeedLlm: Configure an LLM in Settings first. Klar does not need another Home Assistant conversation integration.
llmHint: Klar talks to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Assist chat and the trainer use this same config. No Home Assistant OpenAI or Ollama integration is required.
llmModelsEmpty: No models from this endpoint. Type an id.
llmModelsFail: Could not list models. Type an id.
llmApiKeyHint: Leave empty to keep the stored key. Ollama can stay empty.
llmThinkingHint: Off sends enable_thinking=false (default). Leave off for Gemma 4 so replies stay in the content channel.
